I made the fix and ran the full test suite, which passed. No existing test covers this method, so I didn't add one and didn't check your Anna/Bob example directly.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `DataStore.java`. The count query now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other purchase-order reports use. I also added "cancelled ones left out" to the method's Javadoc. Reps with no purchase orders still appear with 0, and the ordering is the same as before.

I didn't commit anything.
